blindness: Only assigned blind JSON, AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, PLAN.md and official/academic web evidence read. No package keys, proposed explanations, prior reports, database or Git accessed.
assumptions: One diploid autosomal biallelic Mendelian locus, equal gamete probabilities, random fertilization, no mutation or viability differences. Full dominance where phenotype used; phase2 must verify shared model.
Conventional BCE/CE has no year zero. Difficulty estimates are qualitative.
programScope: Official UCEQA programme entrypoints checked. Foundational relevance does not establish full NMT coverage. Detailed programme PDF verification incomplete: biology PDF exceeds web fetch size and history PDF extraction unreadable. No prior-year exam scope assumed current.

questions.reasoning: Aa has unlike alleles. AA/aa are homozygotes; A is not a diploid genotype.
Haploid gametes get one a from aa. A is absent; Aa/AA are diploid combinations.
Full dominance yields dominant phenotype in Aa. It implies neither disappearance, benefit nor higher frequency.
Only A gametes and a gametes unite: every child is Aa. Other outcomes require unavailable gametes.
Own enumeration AA,Aa,aA,aa yields 1:2:1; other options omit heterozygotes or confuse genotype and phenotype.
issues: MEDIUM generous for direct Punnett-square recall.

questions.reasoning: Three of AA,Aa,Aa,aa express dominance: 3:1. Intermediate phenotype requires incomplete dominance; 1:1 is testcross.
issues: MEDIUM generous for direct explicitly qualified recall.
